title: Manasseh’s Families and Inheritance
reflectionText: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah came before the leaders asking for the inheritance commanded through Moses. Their names stand among the families and boundaries of Manasseh. What is it like to hear those five daughters named within the account of the land they received?
